install_steps: Or download the binary for your platform from https://github.com/cloudquery/cloudquery/releases
Authenticate: cloudquery login (required since v6 for most source plugins)
note: Syncs are driven by YAML spec files (kind: source + kind: destination pairs). Most source plugins now require `cloudquery login` — a free CloudQuery Cloud account works. Set CQ_TELEMETRY_LEVEL=none to disable telemetry.
